PatchAddress<WorkbookPatchField>.description: Canonical root field plus optional structured route to a nested node.

field.description: Root canonical field, for example `sections`, `slides`, or `worksheets`.

route.description: Structured canonical route below the field; XML paths are not valid.

text.description: Select text inside the addressed subtree instead of the node itself.

PatchField<WorkbookOptions>.description: A canonical field that accepts patch commands.

PatchNestedValue.description: Any canonical object or nested collection item reachable within six routes.

PatchNodeAddress<WorkbookPatchField>.description: Address a canonical node rather than a text selection.

text.description: Must remain absent when addressing a canonical node.

PatchPathStep.description: A canonical property name or array index used below a patch field.

PatchPosition.description: Insertion or move destination inside an array.

PatchRouteStep.description: One canonical-tree hop from the selected root field.

PatchTextAddress<WorkbookPatchField>.description: Address a text selection inside a canonical subtree.

text.description: Select text inside the addressed subtree.

PatchTextSelection.description: Text selected inside the canonical subtree reached by the address.
